SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT T
ORDER BY
T.ID

SELECT C.ID, C.TASKNAME, C.USERID AUDITEDBYID, C.USERNAME AUDITEDBYNAME, C.CREATEDTIME AUDITEDTIME, C."COMMENT", C.STATUS, C.PROCID, C.ROUTE, F.ID ATTACHMENTID, F.NAME ATTACHMENTNAME FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT C LEFT JOIN T_CORE_FILE F ON F.ID = C.ATTACHMENTID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON C.USERID = U.ID WHERE C.TARGETID = #{targetId} ORDER BY C.ID

SELECT C.USERID FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT C WHERE C.TARGETID = #{targetId} AND C.STATUSCODE = #{statusCode} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT CC WHERE CC.TARGETID = C.TARGETID AND CC.STATUSCODE = 'draft' AND CC.ID > C.ID)
